intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: NOOK helps you discover places and listen to audio guides. This policy describes the data we process when you use the app and the choices available to you.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: Depending on how you use the app, we may process: account identifiers (email), usage preferences (language, notifications), listen history, favorites, saved routes, credit balance, and anonymized technical logs (crashes, performance).

location.title: Location
location.body: With your consent, we use device location to center the map, show nearby places, and improve discovery. You can deny or revoke this permission anytime in device settings; the map remains usable without location.

account.title: Account and authentication
account.body: Creating an account lets you sync routes, favorites, and personal guides. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

audioAndAi.title: Audio, AI guides, and chat
audioAndAi.body: Audio guides generated for your account are private by default. Questions sent to the contextual guide are processed to provide answers based on place content; they may be logged in a limited way for security and service improvement.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep your data while your account is active, then as long as needed for legal obligations or dispute resolution. You may request account deletion (see contact).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under applicable privacy law (including GDPR where relevant), you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, or portability of your data, or object to certain processing. Use in-app settings or the contact below.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For privacy questions: privacy@nook.app (placeholder — replace with the official channel before release).

intro.title: Acceptance
intro.body: By using NOOK, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the application.

service.title: Service description
service.body: NOOK offers place discovery, audio guides, routes, and premium features. Editorial content and generated guides may change; some features require an account or subscription.

account.title: User account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure. Information you provide must be accurate. We may suspend accounts for fraudulent or prohibited use.

content.title: Content and licenses
content.body: Text sourced from Wikipedia is reused under CC BY-SA where applicable. NOOK audio guides and premium itineraries are protected; unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.

purchases.title: In-app purchases
purchases.body: Subscriptions and credit packs are billed through Apple or Google stores under their terms. Credits are used for personal guide generation; they are non-refundable except where required by law.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to misuse the service, harass others, attempt unauthorized access, or use guide chat for illegal or offensive content.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: NOOK is provided "as is". We do not guarantee complete accuracy of third-party content (including Wikipedia). Stay aware on site and follow local regulations.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. For material changes, we will notify you in the app. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Legal questions: legal@nook.app (placeholder — replace before release).
